c1_fact: Exposes MCP server (primary, via npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest), CLI (chrome-devtools navigate/screenshot/status), and programmatic TypeScript API (createMcpServer function, build/src/index.js entry point). All TypeScript-native.
c2_fact: Runs headless on ubuntu-latest. CI workflow installs Chrome via npx puppeteer browsers install chrome. Requires Node.js LTS + Chrome. AppArmor disabled in CI. No external infrastructure.
c4_fact: npm dependencies include @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and puppeteer. PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD can skip browser download if Chrome installed separately. Bundle script creates production bundle without node_modules at runtime. Setup takes a few minutes in CI.
